title: Reading Practice Test 12 – Property & Facilities
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: tin cho thuê, e-mail chuyển văn phòng, bài báo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: thuê nhà, bảo trì, chuyển văn phòng, dự án nhà ở.

questions.content: The apartment complex offers residents ------- access to a gym and swimming pool.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'access' → 'free access' (quyền sử dụng miễn phí).

questions.content: Tenants must give at least 60 days' notice ------- they plan to move out.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện: 'nếu họ định chuyển đi' → 'if'.

questions.content: The property manager ------- the broken window as soon as she was informed.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề sau ở quá khứ (was informed) → hành động chính cũng ở quá khứ đơn 'repaired'.

questions.content: The renovated lobby features ------- lighting and a new seating area.
questions.explanation: Tính từ đứng trước danh từ 'lighting' → 'modern'.

questions.content: Rent can be paid online, by check, ------- in person at the management office.
questions.explanation: Liệt kê các lựa chọn thay thế nhau (trực tuyến, séc, hoặc trực tiếp) → 'or'.

questions.content: The landlord agreed to ------- the lease for another two years.
questions.explanation: 'agree to + V nguyên mẫu' → 'extend' (gia hạn).

questions.content: The new residential tower, ------- will have 300 units, is scheduled to open next spring.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định bổ nghĩa cho vật 'tower', làm chủ ngữ → 'which'.

questions.content: All maintenance requests should be submitted ------- the online tenant portal.
questions.explanation: 'through' = thông qua (một kênh/phương tiện).

questions.content: The house on Maple Avenue sold for $20,000 ------- than its asking price.
questions.explanation: Có 'than' → so sánh hơn: '$20,000 more than' = cao hơn 20.000 đô.

questions.content: Prospective buyers are ------- to schedule a viewing in advance.
questions.explanation: Bị động 'be encouraged to V' = được khuyến khích làm gì.

groups.passage:
To All Residents of Maple Court Apartments:

The water supply to the building will be shut off on Wednesday, May 14, from 9:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. so that plumbers ---131--- old pipes in the basement.

We recommend that you store some water in advance for drinking and cooking. ---132---.

Please also make sure that all faucets are turned off before the work begins. This will prevent flooding when the water is turned back ---133---.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your ---134---. If you have any questions, please contact the management office.

Sincerely,

questions.explanation: 'so that + S + can/will + V' chỉ mục đích → 'can replace'.

options.A: The building was painted last year.
options.B: Bottled water will also be available in the lobby.
options.D: The gym is open until 10:00 P.M.

questions.explanation: Câu trước khuyên trữ nước → câu chèn bổ sung: sảnh có sẵn nước đóng chai.
'turn back on' = mở lại (nước, điện). 'turn off' là tắt – ngược nghĩa.
'appreciate your patience' = cảm ơn sự kiên nhẫn của quý vị; sau tính từ sở hữu cần danh từ. 'patients' = bệnh nhân.

groups.passage:
FOR RENT – Downtown Office Suite

Location: 220 Market Street, 4th floor

questions.content: What is included in the rent?
questions.explanation: '$4,200 per month, utilities included' – utilities = điện, nước, ga. (D) sai: chỉ 6 chỗ đỗ.

questions.content: How can people see the suite?

options.D: By scheduling a visit in advance

questions.explanation: 'Viewings by appointment only' → phải hẹn trước.

groups.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Karim Aziz, Facilities Manager
Date: October 20
Subject: Office move

Dear colleagues,

As you know, our company will move to the Lakeside Tower on November 18. To prepare, each employee will receive packing boxes on November 11. Please label each box with your name and new desk number, which will be sent to you next week.

Movers will transport all boxes and furniture over the weekend of November 16 and 17. Please do not pack computers or monitors; the IT team will move and set them up.

The new office includes a larger cafeteria, a fitness room, and bicycle parking. Parking permits for the Lakeside Tower garage can be requested from my office starting November 1.

Thank you,
Karim Aziz

questions.content: What is the purpose of the e-mail?

options.A: To give instructions about a relocation
options.B: To announce a new fitness program
options.C: To introduce a new facilities manager
options.D: To request volunteers for a project

questions.explanation: E-mail hướng dẫn chuẩn bị chuyển văn phòng tới Lakeside Tower.

questions.content: What are employees told NOT to pack?
questions.explanation: 'Please do not pack computers or monitors; the IT team will move and set them up.'

questions.content: What can employees do starting November 1?
questions.explanation: 'Parking permits… can be requested from my office starting November 1.' Thùng nhận ngày 11/11.

groups.passage:
New Housing Project Approved for Riverside District

The Oakton City Council voted on Tuesday to approve a large housing development in the Riverside district. [1] The project, called Riverside Commons, will include 450 apartments, a public park, and ground-floor space for shops and restaurants.

Thirty percent of the apartments will be offered at below-market rents to families with moderate incomes. [2] Supporters say the project will help ease the city's housing shortage.

Some residents, however, have expressed concern about increased traffic. [3] In response, the developer has agreed to fund a new bus route connecting Riverside Commons to the city center. Construction is expected to begin in March and take about three years. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.D: A decision about a new residential development

questions.explanation: Hội đồng thành phố thông qua dự án nhà ở Riverside Commons.

questions.content: What is indicated about some of the apartments?

options.A: They will be offered at reduced rents.
options.B: They will be sold before construction begins.
options.C: They are reserved for city employees.
options.D: They will be located above a bus station.

questions.explanation: 'Thirty percent of the apartments will be offered at below-market rents' → giá thuê thấp hơn thị trường.

questions.content: The word "concern" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'expressed concern about increased traffic' = bày tỏ lo ngại → worry. 'concern' còn có nghĩa 'doanh nghiệp' (business) – bẫy.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"They fear that hundreds of new residents will crowd local roads."
questions.explanation: 'They' chỉ những cư dân lo ngại về giao thông ở câu trước → vị trí [3], trước giải pháp tuyến xe buýt mới.

groups.passage:
Harborview Apartments – Maintenance Request

Tenant name: Laura Kim · Unit: 5C
Date submitted: March 3
Problem: The heater in the living room is making a loud noise and does not warm the room. The bedroom heater works normally.
Best time for a visit: Weekdays after 5:00 P.M. or Saturday morning
Permission to enter when tenant is not home: No

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Laura Kim
From: Harborview Maintenance
Date: March 4
Subject: Your request

Dear Ms. Kim,

Thank you for your request. Our technician, Diego, is available to visit your unit on Thursday at 6:00 P.M. or Saturday at 10:00 A.M. Please reply to confirm which time works better for you.

If the heater needs a replacement part, the repair may require a second visit. Repairs caused by normal wear and tear are free of charge. However, tenants are responsible for the cost of repairs resulting from misuse.

Best regards,
Harborview Maintenance

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Work Report – Unit 5C
Date: Saturday, March 8
Technician: Diego Alvarez
Work performed: Replaced worn fan motor in living room heater. Heater tested and working properly.
Cause: Normal wear; unit is 12 years old
Charge to tenant: $0
Note: Recommend replacing the bedroom heater within the next year.

questions.content: What problem did Ms. Kim report?

options.A: A heater was not working properly.
options.C: Water was leaking in the kitchen.

questions.explanation: Máy sưởi phòng khách kêu to và không làm ấm phòng.

questions.content: What is suggested about Ms. Kim?

options.A: She recently moved into the apartment.
options.C: She did not want anyone to enter her unit without her.
options.D: She has had the same problem before.

questions.explanation: Mục 'Permission to enter when tenant is not home: No' → không cho vào khi cô vắng nhà.

questions.content: When did the technician most likely visit Ms. Kim's unit?
questions.explanation: Báo cáo công việc ghi thứ Bảy 8/3; e-mail cho biết khung giờ thứ Bảy là 10:00 sáng.

questions.content: Why was Ms. Kim not charged for the repair?

options.D: The problem was caused by normal wear.

questions.explanation: Báo cáo: 'Cause: Normal wear'; e-mail: sửa chữa do hao mòn thông thường được miễn phí.

questions.content: What does the technician recommend?

options.A: Replacing another heater in the future
options.D: Moving the heater to the bedroom

questions.explanation: 'Recommend replacing the bedroom heater within the next year.'
